locale.description:
The interface language this account is served in. It is part of the user
rather than a client-side preference so it follows them across devices —
the browser cookie is a cache of this value, not the source of truth.

message.description: A single message, or one entry per failed validation constraint.

requestId.description: Echoed back in the `x-request-id` header — quote it in bug reports.

password.description:
Deliberately looser than `CreateUserDto.password`: tightening it here would
reject a legitimate credential set before the policy changed, and would let
a caller probe the current policy without an account.

devToken.description: The raw reset token, present only outside production where there is no mail transport to deliver it through instead.

scopeId.description: The org unit, program or course offering the role applies to.

isVoided.description: An annulled result carries a grade on the record and none in standing.

canPublish.description: Whether the caller may promote a proposal to official, as opposed to only proposing one.

attempt.description: Which sitting the grade belongs to. Omitted, it lands on the student’s current attempt; a resit is recorded by naming the next one.

officialGrade.description: Behind `grade:publish`. Null withdraws the published grade.

reason.description: Why the source system refused, when it did.

firstAdminUserId.description: An existing account that becomes this institution’s first institution_admin immediately. Mutually exclusive with firstAdminEmail.

firstAdminEmail.description: An address that has not necessarily registered yet. Creates an institution_admin invitation in the same transaction instead of granting the role immediately. Mutually exclusive with firstAdminUserId.

firstAdminInvitationDevToken.description: The raw token of the first-admin invitation created via firstAdminEmail, present only outside production where there is no mail transport to deliver it through.

terminology.description: Institution label overrides; null means the client uses its own wording.

features.description: Every feature flag, resolved against the platform defaults.

implementedFeatures.description: The flags this platform build actually enforces. A flag outside this list is stored and resolved but gates nothing, so the screen must not offer it as a live control.

terminology.description: Label overrides to merge in; null clears one.

scopeId.description: The org unit, program or course offering the role applies to.

devToken.description: The raw invitation token, present only outside production where there is no mail transport to deliver it through instead.

status.description: The correction verb: a registrar may put an enrolment into any state, including past a full course or back from a mistaken withdrawal.
